status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY COUPLING SCORE WAS COMPUTED
claim_under_test: COUPLING-not-popdesign (wiki/innovate_sweep_2026-09-10.md): the discriminator for de-confounded learned decoding is determinant-to-clade COUPLING, not population design -- HGT decouples a mobile determinant from clade the way meiosis decouples a locus in a cross, so horizontally ACQUIRED determinants should be less clade-coupled than CHROMOSOMAL point mutations.
why_this_is_a_stronger_test_than_the_kil: The surviving kill-test INFERRED coupling from a proxy -- a sensitivity drop under lineage collapse -- across 10 cells with only ONE drug (ciprofloxacin) in the chromosomal arm.

This measures the named mechanism DIRECTLY: how concentrated each determinant's carriers are across lineages, per determinant family, with both arms drawn from the SAME 621 genomes and the SAME lineage partition.
A `survived` verdict bounds the test that ran, never the claim. This is the test the claim actually needs.

substrate_measured_before_freezing.lineage_source: MLST, restricted to the single ecoli_achtman_4 scheme -- an ST number means a different lineage under a different scheme, so mixing schemes would invent lineage identity
substrate_measured_before_freezing.why_the_synonymous_filter_is_load_bearin: mutations.tsv is --mutation_all form and lists every SCREENED position including wildtype (baeS_Q163Q, 16S_A523A). Keeping them turns 'screened and found nothing' into a called mutation and would make the POINT arm mostly noise.

metric.coupling_score: observed largest-lineage fraction among a determinant's carriers MINUS the mean of that same statistic under a null that draws the SAME number of carriers at random from the same 621 genomes
metric.why_a_null_at_matched_N: a determinant with 5 carriers cannot span more than 5 lineages, so raw concentration is mechanically confounded with carrier count. The null holds N fixed so the score is a deviation from chance, not a restatement of prevalence.
metric.secondary: distinct-lineage count divided by its own null expectation, reported alongside

prevalence_matching_decided_in_advance.rule: primary comparison restricted to families with carrier fraction <= 0.50
prevalence_matching_decided_in_advance.derived_not_asserted: measured before freezing: the ACQUIRED arm has ZERO families above 0.50 while POINT has 31 (7 above 0.95). A determinant carried by nearly every genome has a coupling score of ~0 BY CONSTRUCTION, so leaving those in would drag the POINT mean toward zero and bias the test AGAINST the claim.
prevalence_matching_decided_in_advance.cost_stated: the restriction removes 31 POINT families and 0 ACQUIRED families -- it is one-sided, which is why BOTH the restricted and unrestricted results ship and the unrestricted one is never hidden.

verdict_rule.SUPPORTED: mean coupling(POINT) > mean coupling(ACQUIRED) on the prevalence-matched set AND the observed difference exceeds the MAXIMUM of 1000 arm-label permutations.
verdict_rule.WEAK_DIRECTIONAL: mean coupling(POINT) > mean coupling(ACQUIRED) but the difference falls inside the permutation null -- the direction is right and the evidence does not clear its own control. Must be reported as NOT established, not as a partial win.
verdict_rule.FALSIFIED: mean coupling(POINT) <= mean coupling(ACQUIRED) -- the predicted ordering fails outright.
verdict_rule.INDETERMINATE: either arm has fewer than 20 families after filtering.

declared_in_advance: A SUPPORTED verdict would NOT establish that coupling CAUSES the de-confounded failures. It would establish the mechanism's premise -- that acquired and chromosomal determinants differ in clade coupling -- which the surviving kill-test assumed rather than measured. The causal step needs the regime comparison itself.
This is one organism (E. coli) and one lineage definition (7-locus MLST). ST is a coarse lineage unit; a finer phylogeny could change the concentration of every family in both arms.

AMRFinder's own AMR-vs-POINT Subtype is taken as the acquired-vs-chromosomal proxy. It is a good one (POINT is by definition a chromosomal substitution) but it is the tool's classification, not an independent determination of mobility.
